paite: Huchi akha sagihna ahong tun a, khopite a Israel suante a-om lai un, mite Jerusalem ah mi khat bang in akikhawmkhawm uhi.
heading: Jerusalem A Biakna Pat Thak Nawnna

paite: Huchi in Jozadak tapa Jeshua leh a-unaute siampute leh Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh a-unaute adingh ua, Pathian mipa Mosi Dan a akigelh bang a, atung a halmang thillatte lan ding in, Israel' Pathian maitam abawl uhi.
Maitam kingakna tung ah atung ua; gamte a mite ziak in atung uah launa a-om hi: huchi in atung ah TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte zing leh nitak a halmang thillatte ngei alan uhi.
Huan akigelh bang in, biakbukte ankuangluina abawl ua, ahih ding zah in niteng halmang thillatte, dan dungzui in, niteng a sep ding kiphamoh bang in alan uhi.
Huai nung in halmang thillat ngeinate, kha thakte thillatte leh hihsiangthou a om TOUPA ankuanglui sehkhiakte tengteng leh michih a kipan TOUPA a dia uttak a ut thu a thillatte alan uhi.
Akha sagihna ani khat ni a kipan in TOUPA a ding in halmang thillatte alan pan ua; himahleh TOUPA tempul suangphum akiphum nai kei hi.

Sumte suangsek mite kiang leh khutsiam mite kiang ah apia ua; Kura Persia kumpipa a kipan aphalna amuh bang ua tuipi a, Joppa tan a Lebanon tang a kipan sidar singte hon la ding in, Zidonte kiang leh Turate kiang ah, sa, dawn ding leh sathau apia uhi.
heading: Tempul Lam Thak Nawnna

paite: Huchi in akha nihna, Jerusalem a Pathian inn ahong tun uh akum nihna in, Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak tapa Jeshua leh a-unaute siampute leh Levi mite leh koltanna a kipan a Jerusalem a hong paite akipan ua; Levi mite kum sawmnih a upa leh atunglam TOUPA' inn nasepna a heutute hi ding in asep uhi.
Huchi in Pathian inn a nasem mite heutu ding in, Jeshua atapate leh a-unaute, Kadmiel leh atapate, Judah tapate, Henadad tapate, atapate uh leh a-unaute uh Levi mite toh adingkhawmta uhi.

Inn lam mite'n TOUPA tempul suangphum akoih lai un, Israel kumpipa David thupiak bang in, TOUPA phat ding in, siampute pengkulte toh apuan uh asilhsak ua, Levi mite Asaph tapate dakkhutbette aguan uhi.

Huchi in TOUPA phatna leh kipahna piakna in la asakhawm chiat ua, "Amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in Israel lam ah a-om gige ngal a," chi in. Huchi in TOUPA' inn suangphum akoih ziak un mite tengteng aw ngaihtak a kikou in TOUPA aphat uhi.

Himahleh siampute leh Levi mite leh pipute inkote lak a mi tampi, amit mahmah ua hiai inn suangphum akikoih lai a, tua inn masa mute putekte, ngaihtak in akapkhia ua; mi tampi nuamsa in ngaihtak in akikou uhi.
Huchi in mite'n nuamsa a kikouna husa, mite kahna husa toh atheikak thei kei ua: mite ngaihtak in akikou ua, ahusa uh gamlapi ah akiza hi.
